themes.title: Your themes
themes.empty: You have no themes yet. Make one from your current scheme, or import a theme file.
themes.updateNotice: IRCord was updated since your theme was saved. Check that its custom CSS still looks right.
themes.deleteBody: The theme and its background image are removed from your account.
themes.deleteBodyActive: You are using this theme. IRCord changes to the scheme it was based on, and removes the theme and its background image from your account.
themes.importWarning: Custom CSS can change how anything in the workspace looks, including the text it shows. Apply themes only from people you trust. Settings and confirmations always keep the built-in look.

importErrors.too-large: That file is too large to be a theme.
importErrors.not-json: That isn't a theme file. Theme files end in .ircord-theme.json.
importErrors.not-theme: That isn't a theme file. Theme files end in .ircord-theme.json.
importErrors.newer: That theme was made for a newer version of IRCord. Update IRCord, then import it again.
importErrors.css-too-long: That theme has more than {size} KB of CSS.

summary.background: Expects a background image. Choose one in the theme studio.
summary.css: {lines} line of custom CSS | {lines} lines of custom CSS

removed.too-long: The CSS is longer than 64 KB, so none of it is used.
removed.limit: Only the first 1,000 rules are used.
removed.load: Removed a rule that loads an outside file, in {where}. Use the theme background instead. | Removed {count} rules that load outside files, first in {where}. Use the theme background instead.
removed.import: Removed an {'@'}import. Themes can't load other stylesheets. | Removed {count} {'@'}import rules. Themes can't load other stylesheets.
removed.font: Removed an {'@'}font-face. Name a font installed on your device instead. | Removed {count} {'@'}font-face rules. Name fonts installed on your device instead.
removed.escape: Removed a value with a backslash escape, in {where}. | Removed {count} values with backslash escapes, first in {where}.
removed.layer: Removed a cascade layer: {where}. Its rules still apply, without the layer. | Removed {count} cascade layers, first {where}. Their rules still apply, without the layers.
removed.rule-type: Removed a rule type themes can't use: {where}. | Removed {count} rules of types themes can't use, first {where}.
removed.unparsed: The browser couldn't read one rule. | The browser couldn't read {count} rules.

themes.customCssHelp: Apply the CSS in your themes. Colors and backgrounds apply either way.
themes.customCssOff: Custom CSS is off for your account. Your themes keep their CSS, and colors and backgrounds still apply.
themes.customCssOperatorOff: This server doesn't allow custom CSS. Your themes keep their CSS, and colors and backgrounds still apply.
themes.safeHelp: If a theme makes IRCord hard to use, open {address} to load it without your theme, or press Shift F8.

safe.title: Your theme is off for this visit.

studio.title: Theme studio
studio.restoreNote: You have unsaved changes to this theme from earlier in this session.
studio.conflict: This theme was changed on another device since you started editing.
studio.name: Name
studio.modeHelp: Dark and light have their own colors. The app shows the mode you edit.
studio.baseHelp: A mode without its own colors uses this scheme unchanged.
studio.nudged: Some text colors were adjusted so text stays readable.
studio.noUploads: This server doesn't store uploads, so themes can't have a background image. Colors and CSS still work.
studio.needsImage: This theme expects a background image. Choose one to use it.
studio.imageHelp: The image is stored in your account and counts toward your upload limit. Exported themes don't include it.
studio.tooBig: That image is larger than this server accepts.
studio.notInstance: The upload isn't stored on this server.
studio.dimHelp: At least {floor}% keeps message text readable on this image.
studio.panelsHelp: How much the sidebar covers the image. At least {floor}% keeps its text readable.
studio.removedTitle: Some of this CSS isn't used:
studio.cssHelp: CSS can't load files: use the theme background for images. It applies to the workspace only, never to Settings or confirmations. docs/theming.md lists the variables and class names that stay stable.
